entries.title: Psalms 37:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Do not fret because of evildoers, Nor be envious of the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 37:2
segments: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.

entries.title: Psalms 37:3
segments: Trust in the LORD, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on His faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 37:4
segments: Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart.

entries.title: Psalms 37:5
segments: Commit your way to the LORD, Trust also in Him, And He shall bring [it] to pass.

entries.title: Psalms 37:6
segments: He shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, And your justice as the noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 37:7
segments: ¶Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way, Because of the man who brings wicked schemes to pass.

entries.title: Psalms 37:8
segments: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; Do not fret-[it] only [causes] harm.

entries.title: Psalms 37:9
segments: For evildoers shall be cut off; But those who wait on the LORD, They shall inherit the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:10
segments: For yet a little while and the wicked [shall be] no [more]; Indeed, you will look carefully for his place, But it [shall be] no [more].

entries.title: Psalms 37:11
segments: But the meek shall inherit the earth, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:12
segments: The wicked plots against the just, And gnashes at him with his teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:13
segments: The Lord laughs at him, For He sees that his day is coming.

entries.title: Psalms 37:14
segments: The wicked have drawn the sword And have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay those who are of upright conduct.

entries.title: Psalms 37:15
segments: Their sword shall enter their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.

entries.title: Psalms 37:16
segments: A little that a righteous man has [Is] better than the riches of many wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 37:17
segments: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, But the LORD upholds the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 37:18
segments: The LORD knows the days of the upright, And their inheritance shall be forever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:19
segments: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time, And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 37:20
segments: But the wicked shall perish; And the enemies of the LORD, Like the splendor of the meadows, shall vanish. Into smoke they shall vanish away.

entries.title: Psalms 37:21
segments: ¶The wicked borrows and does not repay, But the righteous shows mercy and gives.

entries.title: Psalms 37:22
segments: For [those] blessed by Him shall inherit the earth, But [those] cursed by Him shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:23
segments: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD, And He delights in his way.

entries.title: Psalms 37:24
segments: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For the LORD upholds [him with] His hand.

entries.title: Psalms 37:25
segments: I have been young, and [now] am old; Yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his descendants begging bread.

entries.title: Psalms 37:26
segments: [He is] ever merciful, and lends; And his descendants [are] blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 37:27
segments: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 37:28
segments: For the LORD loves justice, And does not forsake His saints; They are preserved forever, But the descendants of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:29
segments: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell in it forever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:30
segments: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, And his tongue talks of justice.

entries.title: Psalms 37:31
segments: The law of his God [is] in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.

entries.title: Psalms 37:32
segments: The wicked watches the righteous, And seeks to slay him.

entries.title: Psalms 37:33
segments: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.

entries.title: Psalms 37:34
segments: ¶Wait on the LORD, And keep His way, And He shall exalt you to inherit the land; When the wicked are cut off, you shall see [it].

entries.title: Psalms 37:35
segments: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a native green tree.

entries.title: Psalms 37:36
segments: Yet he passed away, and behold, he [was] no [more]; Indeed I sought him, but he could not be found.

entries.title: Psalms 37:37
segments: Mark the blameless [man], and observe the upright; For the future of [that] man [is] peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:38
segments: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together; The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:39
segments: But the salvation of the righteous [is] from the LORD; [He is] their strength in the time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 37:40
segments: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them; He shall deliver them from the wicked, And save them, Because they trust in Him.
